newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank of Greece fixed rate tender due Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Greece fixed rate tender due Wednesday.

text.p: Greece's central bank offered to drain an unspecified amount of 14-day funds at 11.90 percent via a fixed interest rate tender on Wednesday, it said in a statement.

"The Bank of Greece announces that on Wednesday 16 July 1997, it will accept deposits from banks through a fixed rate tender," it said. "The total amount will be set by the Bank of Greece after the submission of bids."
Payment date is July 16 and maturity value date is July 30, it said.
"In case of oversubscription, bids will be satisfied pro rata, with a minimum allotment of 500 million drachmas," it added.
Bids should be submitted by fax between 1130 local (0830 GMT) and 1230 (0930 GMT). --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
